newsitem.title: USA: Tommy Hilfiger to open London store.
newsitem.headline: Tommy Hilfiger to open London store.

text.p: Tommy Hilfiger Corp said Monday it plans to open its first international flagship store in London during the 1998 calendar year.
During the third quarter Tommy announced the signing of an agreement to lease its first international flagship store to be located on New Bond Street in London.

Tommy also recently announced plans to open a smaller London retail store on Sloane Street in the Fall of 1997. The flagship store will be about 18,000 square feet while the Sloan Street store will be about 2,400 square feet, the company said.

The company said it expects the two stores will create exposure in the Britain and generate excitement for the brand across Europe. The company also said it recently signed an agreement with Pepe Jeans London Corp to distribute Tommy men's sportswear throughout Europe, this coming fall.
